text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What's wrong with me? My body has felt so sluggish since that last race...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry... You don't need to worry
about
me! Let's begin the next part of
today's regimen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right! Tuck in those elbows and lay into
the
sandbag with a right—ACK!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch as she thrusts her heel directly
into the
wall.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAH?! I busted open another hole
in the—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-this is strange... Normally,
a kick like
that
would have bust right through...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, she didn't destroy the wall,
but I suppose that means she's lacking her
usual strength.
Perhaps I should revise
her race schedule.
